clue.text: Hit or miss affair resulting in wrongful conviction?

definitions.meaning: a haphazard method of finding out by repeated attempts
read literally: a court hearing that goes wrong and convicts the innocent

explanation.definitionFit: A method of experiment and mistake is hit-or-miss, and a courtroom hearing gone wrong is the literal second sense.

clue.text: Novel, article and story

indicators.note: novel means new or fresh, so the letters of the next word are made new by rearranging

explanation.surface: A list of literary forms: a novel, an article and a story.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Novel' looks like the first item in a list of writing, but it is the anagram signal working on 'article'.
explanation.definitionFit: A recital is a detailed account of events, so it is a narrative or tale.

clue.text: A curious sort of plant

parts.note: rum is an old British word for odd or strange

explanation.surface: Someone remarks on an odd-looking plant.
explanation.definitionFit: The arum is a genus of flowering plant, including the lily called lords-and-ladies.

clue.text: To tackle this crossword is beneath Jack-forgive him!

indicators.note: in a down clue the piece that is beneath another is written after it

parts.note: a jack is a sailor, and AB (able seaman) is the usual crossword abbreviation for one
what the reader is doing: to work out the answers

explanation.surface: A solver protests that doing this puzzle is below Jack's dignity, then begs pardon for him.
explanation.walkthrough: 'is beneath' places SOLVE below AB in this down entry. 'him' is a link word rounding off the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: To absolve someone is to pardon them, releasing them from guilt or blame.

clue.text: A palindrome immortalised

definitions.meaning: a word that reads the same in both directions
made into a god, raised to divine status

explanation.definitionFit: The word reads identically backwards and means made divine, which is being raised to everlasting status.

clue.text: Some of the film is true to life, we hear

indicators.note: what we hear is spoken, so the word is said aloud and a sound-alike is written

explanation.surface: A remark that part of a movie is realistic.
explanation.definitionFit: A reel is a spool holding a length of film, so one reel is part of a whole movie.

clue.text: Letters being sent to distant branch

parts.note: mail that is being sent is going out

explanation.surface: Mail is dispatched to a far-off office of a company.
explanation.walkthrough: Outgoing mail is out post; the two halves come in the reverse of the clue's order.
explanation.definitionFit: An outpost is a remote settlement or station, a far-flung offshoot of a main base.

clue.text: Expert craftsman!

parts.note: craft here means a vessel, so a man expert in handling ships

explanation.definitionFit: A ship's captain qualified to command a merchant vessel is a master of seafaring craft.

clue.text: Master pleaded for a change of ship

indicators.note: the letters of the two words are changed into a new order

explanation.surface: A schoolmaster begs for something different.
explanation.walkthrough: 'for a change' sounds like a master wanting variety, but it signals the anagram of 'Master pleaded'.
explanation.definitionFit: A boat driven by steam-powered paddle wheels is a kind of vessel.

clue.text: A trip with passengers, we hear, makes profits

indicators.note: what we hear is spoken, so the phrase is said aloud and a sound-alike is written

parts.note: a voyage on a liner carrying people: a cruise

explanation.surface: Running a pleasure voyage brings in money.
explanation.definitionFit: Money accrues when it accumulates as gain or interest over time.

clue.text: I earn it from a sort of selling

indicators.note: the answer is made out of the letters of the preceding words, rearranged

explanation.surface: A salesman says this is how he earns his money.
explanation.walkthrough: Inertia selling is sending goods unrequested and charging if they are not returned; the answer names that sort of selling, which is the joke of the seller's boast.
explanation.definitionFit: Inertia selling is a sales trick relying on recipients' unwillingness to act, so the word names the type.

clue.text: Where hangings still take place in London

definitions.text: Where hangings still take place in London

parts.words: Where hangings still take place in London
parts.note: hangings are pictures on walls, not executions: a London art gallery

explanation.definitionFit: The Tate galleries in London display paintings, which are hung on their walls.

clue.text: Nails badly finished off

indicators.note: badly done means the letters of the word are put in the wrong order

explanation.surface: Nails that were poorly hammered home.
explanation.walkthrough: 'finished off' looks like a carpenter's term, but it means killed.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone slain has been killed, which is being disposed of for good.

clue.text: Cover used by an American gangster

annotationWithheld.why: Clue 'Cover used by an American gangster' gives HOOD (cover; US slang for a gangster) as a double definition, not the held answer ROOD; clue or answer misread.
annotationWithheld.clue: Cover used by an American gangster

clue.text: Beat with stick

definitions.meaning: to glue or fasten with an adhesive

explanation.definitionFit: Informally, to give someone a beating is to paste them, and paste is also glue used for sticking.

clue.text: Miss a blank space

parts.note: an empty gap is a void

explanation.surface: A missing gap, an empty space.
explanation.definitionFit: To avoid something is to dodge it, escaping or skipping it.

clue.text: Free delivery

definitions.meaning: a rescue or setting free, also issuing a product

explanation.definitionFit: To liberate someone is to let them go, and a deliverance from captivity is the noun.

clue.text: Very keen supporter voted out by two points?

indicators.note: out means wrong or disordered, so the letters of the word are rearranged

parts.note: two points of the compass, E and E (east)

explanation.surface: A fervent fan ousted by a narrow vote margin.
explanation.walkthrough: 'voted out' reads as an election defeat, but 'out' is the anagram signal; 'two points' are compass points, East twice.
explanation.definitionFit: A devotee is an ardent follower or enthusiast.

clue.text: A gambler's accomplice

explanation.surface: Someone who helps a punter in crime.
explanation.definitionFit: An abetter assists or encourages a wrongdoer, being a partner in crime.

clue.text: Let care be arranged for female in tragedy

indicators.note: the letters of the two words are to be set in a fresh order

explanation.surface: Instructions to organise looking after a woman during a disaster.
explanation.walkthrough: Electra is the heroine of Greek tragedies by Sophocles and Euripides.
explanation.definitionFit: Electra is a woman in Greek drama who avenges her father Agamemnon.

clue.text: Stop the music!

definitions.meaning: to hold back from doing something
a chorus or recurring tune in a song

explanation.definitionFit: To hold back from acting is to desist, and a repeated chorus in a song is the musical sense.

clue.text: I'd fill in the result-it's obvious

indicators.note: one piece is put in to fill another, so it goes inside

explanation.surface: Someone fills in a form with the outcome and remarks that it's plain.
explanation.definitionFit: Something evident is plain to see, clear and apparent.

clue.text: Sweetheart has reason to be passionate

parts.note: the heart (middle letter) of the word sweet is E
a reason for doing something is a motive

explanation.surface: A lover's cause for being ardent.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sweetheart' is read as the heart of 'sweet', its central letter E.
explanation.definitionFit: Emotive means stirring strong feelings, so it is charged with emotion.

clue.text: Involves a silent order

indicators.note: the letters are put into a new order

explanation.surface: Something involves a command given without words.
explanation.walkthrough: 'order' looks like a noun meaning command, but it signals rearranging 'a silent'.
explanation.definitionFit: If one thing entails another, it necessarily brings it along as a consequence.

clue.text: It's about time for a piece of news

indicators.note: about means around or mixed up, so the letters of the word are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone says news is finally due.
explanation.walkthrough: 'It's about time' reads as an impatient phrase; 'It's' is a link and 'about' rearranges TIME.
explanation.definitionFit: An item is a single report or article in a newspaper or bulletin.

clue.text: Going on twelve inches

definitions.meaning: a foot is a unit of twelve inches

explanation.definitionFit: Something afoot is in progress, and a unit measuring twelve inches is the second reading.

clue.text: Stake for backing a mount — may be hotly tipped

definitions.text: a mount — may be hotly tipped

indicators.note: backing means going backwards, so the word is reversed

parts.note: the ante is the stake put up in poker

explanation.surface: A bettor's stake on a horse that is favourite to win.
explanation.walkthrough: 'for backing' and 'hotly tipped' suggest racing bets; the mount is a volcano whose tip is hot.
explanation.definitionFit: Etna is a Sicilian volcano, a mountain whose summit is literally hot.

clue.text: Lincoln has one of these hostelries

definitions.meaning: Lincoln's Inn is one of the four ... of Court for London barristers

explanation.walkthrough: Lincoln's Inn is one of the Inns of Court, the London legal societies to which barristers belong.
explanation.definitionFit: Lincoln's Inn is a legal society, and pubs offering lodging are the ordinary sense.

clue.text: Telephone and give a name

definitions.meaning: to name, as in naming a child

explanation.definitionFit: To ring someone on the phone, and to name someone, are both senses of the verb.

clue.text: Land on a site needing development

indicators.note: the letters of the phrase must be developed, reworked into a new form

explanation.surface: A plot of ground on a building site awaits building.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Land' and 'development' paint a property scene, but 'Land' means a country, a Baltic state.
explanation.definitionFit: Estonia is a Baltic nation, a country being a land.

clue.text: Picture held in fancy

indicators.note: one piece is held by the other, so it sits inside it

explanation.surface: A painting kept in a decorative frame.
explanation.definitionFit: To fancy something is to suppose or dream it up in the mind.

clue.text: The stowaway won't be found on it

definitions.text: The stowaway won't be found on it

parts.words: The stowaway won't be found on it
parts.note: a hidden traveller has no ticket, so he is absent from the ship's register of those travelling

explanation.definitionFit: A ship's manifest records those who paid to travel, which a stowaway never did.
